$comment: Single source of truth for blog visualisation colors and type. Consumed by Hugo templates (site.Data.viz) and scripts/viz/generate-charts.mjs. Do NOT duplicate these values into SCSS.

palette.$comment: Official Qdrant data-visualisation sequence, in order. Qdrant's own series takes position 1 (Primary Red).

surface.$comment: Only used by readableInk(), which picks legible text for a coloured cell. Chrome colours come from the --qi-* CSS tokens, not from here.

type.$comment: Named roles, not arithmetic. Every chart kind uses the same five sizes.

sequential.$comment: Sequential ramp for heatmaps, built on the official Neon Blue #6047FF. Deliberately NOT Amaranth: red reads as alarm when the darkest cells are the best values, and Amaranth already means 'the Qdrant series' in categorical charts.
